quotes.quote: ghostty + Mac OS gives me all the organization I need for multi-agenting
quotes.excerpt: Claude Code, Codex, Pi clis all for varying levels of work. VS Code when needed. I review agent messages, some specs/plans, and conduct local code reviews with Plannotator [1]. For skills, I have a bunch of custom ones for my own workflow. and for public skills I really only use the interrogate skill from cursor's lauren [2]. Key workflow stuff: - Almost all work I do gets done in a git worktree. - ghostty + Mac OS g
